care_note: The actual CARE acceptance month is not public. ISSRE research decisions can be early (June 15) or final (July 8); other tracks differ. cikm_note: The original CIKM 2024 CFP is now a placeholder. The July 16 notification is supported by the contemporaneous CFP mailing-list archive.
